official_category_name: Colleges of Health Sciences and Technology
title: Nigeria Colleges of Health Sciences and Technology
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for current Nigerian institutions in NBTE's Colleges of Health Sciences and Technology category.
methodology: SoftData reconciled the complete 129-entry NBTE Colleges of Health Sciences section before generating the dataset. Names and locations were normalized to current canonical forms and mapped to ng-states. Hospital-only institutes, medical schools, nursing-adjacent units and one unresolved generic source entry were excluded and documented. The public contract contains only the five base fields.
source_hierarchy: Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare

sources.title: 25th Edition 2025 Directory of Accredited Programmes
sources.purpose: Primary roster boundary for Colleges of Health Sciences and Technology.
missing_or_incomplete_fields: state_id is not a source field
some source names contain spelling and punctuation errors
hospital-school and nursing-adjacent rows require category reconciliation

sources.title: Approved Institutions
sources.purpose: Confirm the official category boundary and its separation from nursing, polytechnic, monotechnic and IEI categories.

inclusion_boundary: Only current separately recognized institutions in NBTE's Colleges of Health Sciences and Technology category; nursing and midwifery institutions are reserved for a separate dataset.
exclusion_rules: Universities, university faculties and medical schools
teaching-hospital schools or institutes without a separately recognized college
polytechnics, monotechnics, agriculture colleges, IEIs, VEIs and technical colleges
regulator_overlap_policy: NBTE classification is primary. Health-profession regulators and government publications may resolve identity, status or naming conflicts but are not required to publish every NBTE institution.
update_frequency: Review on each new NBTE directory or material regulatory roster update.
transitions_and_former_names: Category movements, former names, duplicate identities and hospital absorption concerns are documented in the reconciliation manifest.
known_limitations: The NBTE source is not active-only and does not normalize state_id.
The source section uses Colleges of Health Sciences while the approved-institutions page uses Colleges of Health Sciences and Technology.
No programme or profession fields are exposed in this roster-only contract.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. NBTE source publications retain their own rights. This pass adds only the static dataset foundation; websites, logos and API routes are deferred.
